title: Wider-framework connection and significance of the Borromean h^4 factorisation
html:
Remark. Wider-framework connection and significance of the Borromean h^4 factorisation

Connection to the wider framework

The two ingredients each acquired a categorical home elsewhere in the framework after the initial derivation:

  • Step 1 (the polynomial form χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶) shares its Wedderburn partition-indexed framework with the q-heat-kernel Peter–Weyl decomposition and the Habiro residue-sum equivalence. Note the q-heat-kernel proposition supplies the q-Laplacian eigenvalues \mu_\lambda(q) — heat-flow decay rates, not the braid-character values \chi^\lambda(\beta); the polynomial form itself comes from the projector route below or from direct substitution on the closed-form trace. The categorical projector onto the (2,1) channel is the \mathbf{e}_- minus-eigenspace idempotent of the Hecke quadratic relation q\sigma^2 = (q^2 − 1)\sigma + q, formalised sorry-free in QOU.Hecke.SpectralProjector (eminus_idem, eplus_eminus_orthogonal, eplus_add_eminus = 1). Closed-form trace computation on V^{\otimes 3} can be done via the Cayley–Hamilton block reduction QOU.Braiding.HeckeGenPolyReduction.hecke_gen_poly_reduction.

  • Step 2 (the Markov normalisation y_{(2,1)}(q=1) = 1/4) is the q = 1 evaluation of the exact closed-form Wenzl weight y_{(2,1)}(q) = 1/[2]_q^2 established in prop:h3-markov-wenzl-weights. The full \mathrm{H}_3 weight vector is \bigl([4]_q/[2]_q^3,\ 1/[2]_q^2,\ 0\bigr), evaluating at q = 1 to the non-uniform (\tfrac12, \tfrac14, 0) — the sign channel carries zero weight identically (Temperley–Lieb quotient), and the Jones-normalised trace is chiral, so no bar-involution uniformity applies.

Concretely, the R-matrix derivation in Step 1 of this proof can be reformulated equivalently as: extract the \mathbf{e}_- component of \sigma_1^{-1}\sigma_2 on V_{1/2}^{\otimes 3}, take the h^4 coefficient of its trace. The \mathbf{e}_- idempotent is the categorical replacement for the explicit 8 \times 8 R-matrix computation; both are now valid Lean entry points to the same χ^{(2,1)}(β_Bor) = 2 − 3h⁴ − h⁶ identity.

Significance

The Borromean h^4 = -3/4 — the first topological invariant of the Borromean linking, the part of the Jones polynomial that distinguishes \mathcal{B}_3 from the trivial 3-component unlink — is now derived from first principles within \mathrm{H}_3(q). The chain is:

Step Source Result
1 U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2) R-matrix on V_{1/2}^{\otimes 3} \chi^{(2,1)}(\beta_{\mathrm{Bor}}) = 2 - 3h^4 - h^6
2 Markov normalisation for c = 3 link closure $y_{(2,1)}(q=1) = 1/4 = 1/[2]_q^2
3 Combined Frobenius expansion h^4(\mathrm{tr}_M) = (-3) \cdot (1/4) = -3/4

The derivation is purely categorical — no empirical fitting, no free parameters. Each ingredient (\check{R}, the Hecke relation, the Schur–Weyl decomposition, the Markov normalisation [2]_q^{c-1}) is a standard categorical / topological object whose form is determined by the framework's existing structure.

Scope note. This closes the within-\mathrm{H}_3 categorical chain (the 3-strand side of the Borromean story). It does not resolve the cross-algebra obstruction linking 5-strand A_5 fiber action to 3-strand \mathrm{H}_3 — that is the question posed by (conj:s5-so3-fiber-action), and it remains open: eight candidate cross-algebra functors have been refuted.
